attacks.name: Tactical Knife
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Bleed|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§bleed§Bleed| special condition.
|!wild| |*Pierce|: Change 1 of the defender's |!critical|, |!wild|, or |!block| results to a Blank.

attacks.name: Fury Special
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
|!wild| |*Pierce|: Change 1 of the defender's |!critical|, |!wild|, or |!block| results to a Blank.

attacks.name: Lead from the Front
steps: After this attack is resolved, an allied |£shield-agents-grunts£&*S.H.I.E.L.D. Agents&| within |!range| 3 of this character may Advance |!range_small| Toward the defender. Then that |*S.H.I.E.L.D. Agents| may make a |*Pistols| attack targeting the defender.

superPowers.name: Last Line of Defense (Affiliation: S.H.I.E.L.D.)
superPowers.body: If you have fewer VPs than your opponent, the first time each Round an allied character is Dazed or KO'd by an enemy effect, after the effect is resolved, you score 1 VP.|\|If you have an equal number or more VPs than your opponent, when an enemy character damages an allied character with an attack, the allied character may spend 1 |!power|. If it does, after the attack is resolved, the allied character may Advance |!range_small| Toward the attacking character.

superPowers.name: Call in the Cavalry
superPowers.body: If there is no allied |*S.H.I.E.L.D. Agents| in play, Place it in play within |!range| 3 of this character with an Activated token. It may immediately interact with one Extract objective token. It is part of your Squad.

superPowers.name: Director of S.H.I.E.L.D.
superPowers.body: When an Allied |*S.H.I.E.L.D. Agents| is within |!range| 3 of this character, it may reroll 1 of its attack or defense dice. Additionally, when an Allied |*S.H.I.E.L.D. Agents| within |!range| 3 of this character deals |!damage| or suffers |!damage| from an enemy effect, this character gains 1 |!power|.
